duration.value: instantaneous DESCRIPTION You instantly teleport to a distance of 5 feet per two ninja levels. The destination must be an unoccupied space within line of sight. The square you cast this ninjutsu from becomes filled with smoke as if by a smoke stick when this ninjutsu is cast.
